decisions: User-approved (plan agreed in session, ticket tickets/T-007-json-output.md, issue https://github.com/UBayouski/tracenotes/issues/18): JSON is a second output format of the existing `render` command (`--format markdown|json`), not a new command. `group` already prints JSON but it is the grouping stage's internal data without links, a shown count or a schema version.

Agent choice, written into the ticket (criterion 4): `renderMarkdown` is now built from the same `notesDocument` the JSON prints, so the two formats cannot drift apart. The Markdown output must not change by a byte; the pre-existing render tests are unchanged and pass.

Agent choice, ticket criterion 5: text in the document (subject, scope, section titles, breakingNotes) is raw, with no Markdown escaping. JSON.stringify does the only escaping. Markdown escaping stays in renderMarkdown only.

Agent choice, ticket criterion 9: the --format value is compared exactly as given ('markdown' or 'json'); no trimming, no lower-casing (AGENTS.md rule 6, Validate Before You Normalize). 'JSON' and ' json' are rejected with exit 2.
Agent choice, ticket criterion 9 and Out of scope: when an option is repeated the last one wins, the same as the existing --repo-url handling. Rejecting repeated options is out of scope.

Agent choice, ticket Out of scope: ignored merge commits and malformed records are not listed in the document, only counted (counts.ignored, counts.malformed), the same information the Markdown closing line carries. `group` and `log` already print the details.
Agent choice, ticket criterion 2: every key is always present (null or [] when there is no value) and key order is fixed, so consumers do not need existence checks. schemaVersion is the number 1.

Existing behavior kept on purpose: `render` with empty stdin exits 2 with usage for both formats (T-004 decision); a valid empty document is only reachable from a non-empty stream that has nothing to show (merge-only) or from the library with groupCommits([]).
notes:
Task: T-007 JSON output mode for machine consumers. Full acceptance criteria are in tickets/T-007-json-output.md (part of this diff) and in issue #18. Project rules are in AGENTS.md: 1 No Orphan Notes (every entry carries its source SHA), 2 Nothing Vanishes (every input commit is counted), 4 zero runtime dependencies, 6 Validate Before You Normalize; convention: src/cli.ts is the only module that touches process streams, and CLI argument changes need child-process cases in tests/cli.test.ts.

Changed files: src/render.ts (new exported types NotesDocument/NotesSection/NotesEntry/NotesSource/NotesCounts, new notesDocument() and renderJson(), renderMarkdown() refactored to print from notesDocument(), old private source() replaced by toSource()/sourceText()), src/cli.ts (--format option on render, USAGE), src/index.ts (exports), tests/render.test.ts and tests/cli.test.ts (new cases), tickets/T-007-json-output.md (new). src files and the ticket are staged; the test files are unstaged on purpose, the review should cover both.

Constraints that hold upstream (unchanged files): entry.sha comes from src/gitlog.ts, which accepts only 40 lowercase hex characters, so commitUrl is built from validated input. entry.prNumber comes from src/commit.ts and is a safe integer or null (an oversized '(#9007199254740993)' gives null and stays in the subject; tested). repoUrl is validated by checkRepoUrl() in both notesDocument() and, earlier, in the CLI before stdin is read. groups.total counts parsed commits only; malformed records are outside total by the existing T-003/T-004 design, which is why the identity is shown + ignored === total.

Checks run on the uncommitted tree: `npm run check` (tsc + node --test) passes, 122 tests, 0 failures (101 before this change; none of the 101 were edited). Manual run on the real repository history with --format json --repo-url printed a valid document. Not tested: very large inputs; non-UTF-8 input; behavior of consumers. README.md is not updated in this change (it does not document `render` at all yet).
